title: Calvin's Crazy Workout!
author: Drayden Finch
desc: For my best bud Calv so he can look and feel his best!

ex.note: Light warmup, increase numbers if too easy, just feel it out!
Warmup, stick to light weight and do some stretches after
Primary lift, always start heavy first and decrease weight as you go. But for your first time, try out different weights at your own pace and find where you struggle.
Try with cables and dumbbells, see which one you prefer
Essentially just really fast squats. Keep form, but you're really just getting blood to the legs. Stretch after.
Primary movement. Try leg press and let me know if you prefer squats instead. Both are good, but squats also train core and hips.
I recommend looking up a tutorial so you don't over rely on your lower back. Feel it in your hamstrings, not your back.
Don't sleep on the calves
Look up a tutorial, very good for mobility and stability.
Highly recommend looking up tutorial or asking someone to teach you. Deadlifts aren't inherently dangerous but bad form will lead to bad results.
Do as many as you can for each set, push yourself
Look up tutorial. Possible to do on smith machines just go lighter.
